ignoreCommand: if [ -z "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA" ]; then exit 1; fi; changed="$(git diff --name-only "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA" HEAD)"; [ -n "$changed" ] || exit 1; printf '%s\n' "$changed" | grep -qv '^runtime-config.json$' && exit 1; exit 0

headers.value: camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=(), payment=(), usb=(), accelerometer=(), gyroscope=(), magnetometer=()

default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' https://telegram.org; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob: https:; connect-src 'self'; frame-src https://buildin.ai https://*.buildin.ai; font-src 'self' data:; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; frame-ancestors 'self' https://web.telegram.org https://telegram.org https://*.telegram.org; upgrade-insecure-requests
